widget.name: Layout Overlay
widget.description: Place clickable, draggable shape markers at X/Y coordinates over a background layout image. Shapes can be built-in, custom SVG paths or images. Every interaction can trigger a Mendix action.

property.caption: Markers
property.description: One object per marker.

property.caption: X
property.description: Horizontal position. Must be editable for drag/move to save.

property.caption: Y
property.description: Vertical position (0 = top). Must be editable for drag/move to save.

property.caption: Shape
property.description: Built-in: circle, square, triangle, diamond, star, hexagon, pin, cross, check, warning, thumbs-up, thumbs-down. Custom: "svg:<path d>" (24x24 viewBox) or "url:<image url>". Empty = circle.

property.caption: Color
property.description: CSS color (e.g. "#2e7d32").

property.caption: Size (px)
property.description: Marker size in pixels. Falls back to default size.

property.caption: Rotation (deg)
property.description: Rotation of the shape in degrees (clockwise).

property.caption: Label
property.description: Text shown beside the marker.

property.caption: Tooltip
property.description: Text shown in the browser tooltip when hovering the marker.

property.caption: Background image
property.description: Layout / floor plan image.

property.caption: Background URL
property.description: Dynamic image URL. Overrides the static image when it returns a value.

property.caption: Coordinate unit
property.description: Percent: X and Y are 0-100 of canvas. Pixels: X and Y are in canvas width/height units.

property.caption: Canvas width
property.description: Reference width; sets aspect ratio, and the X range in pixel mode. The canvas scales to its container.

property.caption: Canvas height
property.description: Reference height; sets aspect ratio, and the Y range in pixel mode.

property.caption: Default marker size (px)
property.description: Marker size in pixels when no Size attribute value is available.

property.caption: Default marker color
property.description: CSS color used when no Color attribute value is available.

property.caption: Show grid
property.description: Draw a background grid to help positioning.

property.caption: Snap to grid
property.description: Snap step in coordinate units while dragging. 0 = off.

property.caption: Allow editing
property.description: Show an Edit toggle. In edit mode markers can be dragged, nudged with arrow keys, and the selected marker's shape/color/size/position can be changed (when attributes are editable).

property.caption: Start in edit mode
property.description: Open the widget with editing already switched on.

property.caption: Clicked X (output)
property.description: Receives the X of an empty-canvas click before "On canvas click" fires.

property.caption: Clicked Y (output)
property.description: Receives the Y of an empty-canvas click before "On canvas click" fires.

property.caption: Moved X (output)
property.description: Fallback when the marker's own X/Y are read-only: receives the new X after a drag. Read it in the "On marker moved / changed" action (a context object, e.g. the page data view).

property.caption: Moved Y (output)
property.description: Fallback when the marker's own X/Y are read-only: receives the new Y after a drag.

property.caption: On marker click
property.description: Action executed when a marker is clicked. Runs in the context of that marker object.

property.caption: On marker double click
property.description: Action executed when a marker is double clicked.

property.caption: On marker right click
property.description: Action executed when a marker is right clicked (browser menu is suppressed).

property.caption: On marker moved / changed
property.description: Fires after X/Y (or other attributes) were written. Commit the object here if needed.

property.caption: On canvas click
property.description: Fires on an empty-canvas click in edit mode, after Clicked X/Y are set. Use to create a new marker.

property.caption: Title
property.description: Bold first line of the hover card, e.g. the bay name. Can use marker attributes as parameters.

property.caption: Lines
property.description: One entry per line in the hover card. Each line is a text template evaluated for the hovered marker, e.g. "Avg: {1} min Util: {2}%". Lines that evaluate to empty text are hidden.

property.caption: Text
property.description: Line text; use {1}, {2}... for marker attributes.

property.caption: Bold
property.description: Render this line in bold.

property.caption: Hover delay (ms)
property.description: Delay before the card appears.

property.caption: Legend items
property.description: Optional legend shown above the canvas, e.g. "Planned and Occupied" in green.

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Legend text.

property.caption: Color
property.description: CSS color of the swatch.

property.caption: Shape
property.description: Same names as the marker Shape attribute (circle, square, triangle, ...).
